rules.text: Masking tapes and any other adhesive tapes must not be used on the black side of Sikaplan® WP Tape- 200.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: The Sikaplan® WP Tape-200 system consists of a modified PVC tape and a choice of Sikadur® epoxy adhesives for bonding. The following system products must be used: Tape Sikaplan® WP Tape-200 (width: 200 mm) Adhesives Suitable adhesives are: Sikadur®-31 CF Slow Sikadur®-31 CF Normal Sikadur®-31 CF Rapid Sikadur Combiflex® CF Adhesive Normal Sikadur Combiflex® CF Adhesive Rapid Ancillary Products: Sikaplan® WP Membrane Systems Sarna Seam Cleaner
rules.heading: System Information > System structure

rules.text: Compatible with Sikaplan® WP 1100 / 1120 / 2101 / 2110 Series of membranes
